The factory is `NewDBDriver` in `store/db/db.go`, which selects the driver and calls `mysql.NewDB(profile)` for MySQL:

```13:24:store/db/db.go
// NewDBDriver creates new db driver based on profile.
func NewDBDriver(profile *profile.Profile) (store.Driver, error) {
	var driver store.Driver
	var err error

	switch profile.Driver {
	case "sqlite":
		driver, err = sqlite.NewDB(profile)
	case "mysql":
		driver, err = mysql.NewDB(profile)
	case "postgres":
		driver, err = postgres.NewDB(profile)
```

A repo-wide search shows no other call sites for `mysql.NewDB` and no other imports of `github.com/usememos/memos/store/db/mysql` besides `store/db/db.go`. All other code obtains a MySQL driver through the factory, e.g. `cmd/memos/main.go:57`, `store/test/store.go:28`, and `store/test/store.go:50` (all use `db.NewDBDriver`).

The only other direct `mysql.DB` construction is a zero-value `&DB{}` in `store/db/mysql/auth_config_test.go:12`, used to unit-test error classification without opening a connection — not a functional driver setup via `NewDB`.

`store/test/containers.go:145` does call `sql.Open("mysql", dsn)`, but that is a raw `database/sql` connection for creating test databases in a container, not construction of the memos store MySQL driver type.
